intro: Football is Cameroon's passion, and the Indomitable Lions are among Africa's most famous teams.

chapters.title: Football
text: In 1990 Cameroon became the first African team to reach a World Cup quarter-final, with Roger Milla dancing at the corner flag. It won Olympic gold in 2000 and five Africa Cups of Nations.

chapters.title: Athletes
text: Françoise Mbango won two Olympic triple jump golds. Joel Embiid and Pascal Siakam star in the NBA, and Francis Ngannou became UFC heavyweight champion.
